packageRules.description: A The Lounge minor is a feature release of this image (VERSIONING.md in mbologna/.github: an upstream update bumps by its own impact). Committed as feat, auto-release makes it a minor, e.g. v1.0.0+up4.5.2 to v1.1.0+up4.6.0. Patches keep the preset's chore(deps) and release a patch.
A The Lounge major is a breaking change for this image's users (config, plugins, Node). Committed as a breaking feat, auto-release makes it a major, e.g. v1.1.0+up4.6.0 to v2.0.0+up5.0.0.
